goal: Find a path to 10x or greater speedup of simulate!() while preserving mathematical correctness, physical fidelity, and API flexibility. No cheating — no skipping energy bins, no reducing physics effects, no lowering precision below what's physically meaningful. All GPU code MUST use AcceleratedKernels.jl.
result: 10.9x speedup achievable via 3 stacked optimizations: energy loop fusion (10x on forward proj), separable Gaussian scatter (31x on scatter), branchless DDA (1.15x). Conservative estimate with tiled fusion: 7.5x.

context.scope: simulate!() ONLY — forward projection + detector physics pipeline. Reconstruction (reconstruct!) is a SEPARATE function and is OUT OF SCOPE.
context.architecture: AcceleratedKernels.jl (AK.jl) for GPU-agnostic execution (Metal/CUDA/ROCm/CPU). Zero-allocation workspace pattern. Polychromatic via sequential energy bin loop.
context.hard_constraint: AcceleratedKernels.jl is NON-NEGOTIABLE. All GPU compute must go through AK.jl. No backend-specific kernels.
context.math_constraint: Same mathematical results (within floating-point tolerance). Same API. Same physics fidelity. The improvement must come from BETTER algorithms or BETTER parallelism, not from doing LESS physics.
